bio.headline: Forged between code and equations
bio.para1: Graduated in Computer Science with a Master's in Mathematics and Computer Science from the University of Cantabria. After several years as a software developer, I spent five years in research and university teaching before working independently, combining education and consulting.
bio.para2: For over seven years I have been helping students and professionals strengthen their skills in programming, mathematics and artificial intelligence — from academic support and learning from scratch to technical interview preparation and real-world project development.

specs.headline: Areas of Expertise

programming.title: Programming
programming.body: From core paradigms to data structures, algorithms, concurrency and design patterns — with a focus on best practices and leveraging AI without losing your own judgment.

backend.title: Backend Development
backend.body: Building REST APIs and microservices, integrating SQL and NoSQL databases, cloud deployment and DevOps workflows with Docker and Git.

math.title: Computational Mathematics
math.body: Calculus, linear algebra, numerical methods, discrete mathematics and compilers/automata.

ai.title: Artificial Intelligence
ai.body: Machine Learning, Deep Learning, LLMs and multi-agent programming, with mathematical foundations and hands-on implementation.

data.title: Data Analysis & Statistics
data.body: Probability, applied statistics, data mining, big data and time series.

cycles.title: DAM / DAW Vocational Training
cycles.body: Intensive preparation for Higher Level cycles. Support in the most demanding technical modules and expert mentoring for final projects.
